title: Model costs get a reality check
summary:
Model costs are easier to estimate, keys are easier to configure, and a noir storyboard app joined the catalog.

Enter’s Pollen estimates now use observed model usage when available, with workload-based estimates as a fallback. A new public `/api/model-stats` endpoint exposes aggregated usage for the last seven complete days.

A new Bring Your Own Pollen guide explains how apps can let users authorize with Pollinations, while the authorize screen more plainly says which app receives a key. API key model selection now shows display names alongside API IDs; the key form also received accessibility improvements.

@eneryu’s Onyx, which turns scripts into noir-style storyboard sequences, was added to the app catalog. The catalog also consolidated two listings for TeleChars AI.

daily.title: Public model usage stats
daily.text: Query `/api/model-stats` for aggregated model usage across the last seven complete days. Results are cached for six hours.
